name: Dark Shadow
description:
When played: Gain "Attack Power" equal to the Current Elemental Dice Cost of the devoured card with the highest cost, and gain Usage(s) based on the number of devoured cards with said cost.
End Phase: Deal Electro DMG equal to the "Attack Power" of this card.
When your active character takes DMG: Reduce DMG taken by 1, then this card's Usage(s) -2.
